name: harvester-management-system-backend
description: Backend API for Harvester Management System

scripts.dev: node scripts/start-mongo-rs.js && npx prisma db push --skip-generate && npx prisma db seed && nodemon src/index.ts
scripts.start: npx prisma db push --skip-generate && npx prisma db seed && node src/dist/index.js
scripts.db:reset: npx prisma db push --force-reset --skip-generate && npx prisma db seed
